headline: Ruins Scar the Map as Fishermans Row Boils Over
war_summary: Since our last edition the first ruins have appeared on the ledger: a strategic work apiece in Fishermans Row, Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse now stands demolished, and the count reads 286 bases Colonial, 140 Warden, three in no-man's-land. Fishermans Row is the busiest field on the map, thirty-six flag events in a day and the last logged at this dispatch's very minute, Eidolo and Black Well the most fought-over posts; seven works there fly Colonial colors against one Warden. Stlican Shelf, silent at our last filing, has re-erupted with thirty-three events, Wardens holding six works to two. Weathered Expanse keeps its dreadful arithmetic, a day's toll past thirty thousand, the flag count now five Warden to three. The Nevish Line storm has cooled, though its day's bill tops three thousand. Mooring County stayed in motion into late evening, Colonial losses now outpacing Warden there, and on the Farranac Coast Colonials raised their flag over three more works about The Bone Haft. In the otherwise eventless Dead Lands the casualty ledger leaps, Warden losses above a thousand in the last hour alone. The Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow have fallen quiet. Day 272; no victor declared.
